rust_summary: Player about to travel through an End gateway, cancellable (`native_player_teleport_end_gateway`).
doc_summary: A player is about to travel through an End gateway (`native_player_teleport_end_gateway(player, name, gateway, cancel)`). Set `cancel` to leave them at the entrance without starting the gateway cooldown. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_teleport_end_gateway@.
